tickets.title: Project scaffold + cozy pixel theme
acceptanceCriteria: Flutter project lil_routine created with features/ + core/ folder structure
Cozy pixel theme implemented: warm palette (cream/peach/sage/dusty pink), pixel heading font, styled buttons/cards/chips
flutter build apk succeeds and APK installs on the user's Android phone
App opens showing themed LilRoutine placeholder home with mascot placeholder and styled button

tickets.title: Local data layer (SQLite + repositories)
acceptanceCriteria: SQLite tables: entries (unified water/food log), habits, settings, favorites
Typed repository classes with create/read/update/delete
Debug-only seed/clear helpers available (hidden in release)
Data persists across app restarts on device (verified via debug screen)

tickets.title: Water tracking core
acceptanceCriteria: Daily water goal is user-settable
Tap-to-add glass with custom glass sizes and undo last entry
Animated water ring on Today screen reflecting real totals
Water entries persist across app restarts on device

tickets.title: Water history
acceptanceCriteria: 7-day and 30-day bar view of water intake
Tapping a day shows that day's entries
Entries can be deleted and totals update immediately

tickets.title: Manual food logging + recents/favorites
acceptanceCriteria: Log sheet: meal type (breakfast/lunch/dinner/snack), name, calories, optional macros
Portion multiplier 0.5x/1x/1.5x/2x applied at log time
Every log is saved to personal recents; favorites re-log in one tap
Today screen calorie ring with remaining budget updates correctly, fully offline

tickets.title: Open Food Facts lookup
acceptanceCriteria: Search field queries Open Food Facts API and shows result cards with nutrition
Confirming a result logs it through the manual-log path
No result or offline falls back gracefully to manual entry without blocking

tickets.title: Habit engine + derived habits
acceptanceCriteria: Water-goal habit auto-computed from water data (no manual check-in)
User-defined eating habits auto-checked where computable from food entries, manual toggle otherwise
Current and best streaks computed per habit
Habits screen reflects real logged data accurately on device

tickets.title: Habit history grid
acceptanceCriteria: Month-view contribution grid per habit in pixel style
Tapping a day shows that day's habit state/detail
Grid data matches computed streak numbers

tickets.title: AI gating + Gemini key management
acceptanceCriteria: Settings AI section: locked state UI with explainer + Google AI Studio link + key paste field + test connection button
Key stored in secure storage, never logged or synced
Feature-flag layer: AI surfaces show locked state when no key is set
Valid key unlocks AI features; invalid key shows a clear error

tickets.title: AI food logging (photo + text via Gemini)
acceptanceCriteria: Photo capture or text description sent to Gemini with strict JSON schema prompt
Result shown as a confirmation card; never auto-logged; editable before confirm
Confirmed logs go through the existing manual-log path and appear in recents
Locked cleanly when no API key is set

tickets.title: Settings completion + reminders
acceptanceCriteria: Glass size, daily water goal, daily calorie goal all editable and persisted
Local reminder notifications, max 1-2 per day, cozy tone
Every setting change visibly affects app behavior on device

tickets.title: Cozy pixel polish pass
acceptanceCriteria: Real pixel art assets: icons, mascot states, goal-complete celebration
Chunky stepped animations and tactile tap feedback throughout
Empty states have cozy art/copy
App subjectively feels like LilRoutine, not a generic tracker

tickets.title: Release prep (icon, versioning, signed APK)
acceptanceCriteria: Proper LilRoutine app icon and display name
Version code/name configured
Signed release APK builds and installs on the user's phone
App used normally for a full day without issues
